<?php
function unionReviewRight(): int { echo "RHS;"; return 9; }
$reader = new class {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return $incoming !== "missing"; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): string|false { echo "G;"; if ($incoming === "zero") { return 0; } return false; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; }
};
$selector = "zero";
echo empty($reader->$selector) ? "EMPTY_ZERO;" : "BAD_EMPTY;";
$answer = $reader->$selector ?? unionReviewRight();
echo $answer === "0" ? "STRING_ZERO;" : "BAD_ZERO;";
$selector = "false";
echo empty($reader->$selector) ? "EMPTY_FALSE;" : "BAD_FALSE_EMPTY;";
$answer = $reader->$selector ?? unionReviewRight();
echo $answer === false ? "FALSE;" : "BAD_FALSE;";
$selector = "missing";
echo ($reader->$selector ?? unionReviewRight()) === 9 ? "FALL;" : "BAD_FALL;";
$reader = null;
echo $selector === "missing" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
function nullableReviewBadRight() { echo "BAD_RHS;"; return 9; }
$reader = new class {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "ISSET;"; return true; }
    public function __get(?string $incoming): ?string {
        global $reader;
        echo "GET;";
        $reader = null;
        return 1;
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; throw new Exception("receiver-nullable"); }
};
$selector = "gone";
$destination = 42;
try { $destination = $reader->$selector ?? nullableReviewBadRight(); }
catch (Exception $failure) { echo $failure->getMessage(); echo ";"; echo $failure->getPrevious()->getMessage(); echo ";"; echo $failure->getPrevious()->getLine(); echo ";"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
echo $reader === null ? "CLEARED;" : "BAD_RECEIVER;";
echo $selector === "gone" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_NAME;";
echo "DONE;";
